codeReview.summary: Implementation fully satisfies all requirements. GET /api/v1/evaluations/:id/results returns 200 with accuracy metric and sample count for completed tasks, 409 for pending/running tasks, 404 for not found, 400 for invalid UUID, and supports pagination for large prediction sets.

summary: Feature implementation passes review. All 7 requirements verified: (1) Completed task returns 200 with results - implemented in GetResults handler at line 360+, (2) Results include accuracy metric - EvaluationResultItem.Accuracy field populated from repository, (3) Results include sample count - EvaluationResultItem.SampleCount field populated, (4) Pending/running returns 409 - status check at line 381-385 returns 409 Conflict, (5) Not found returns 404 - repository check at line 368-374 returns 404, (6) Pagination supported - predictions_page and predictions_limit query params parsed at lines 405-428, (7) Proper JSON structure - GetResultsResponse includes results array and predictions object with pagination metadata. Tests cover all scenarios: TestGetResults_CompletedTask, TestGetResults_PendingTask, TestGetResults_RunningTask, TestGetResults_NotFound, TestGetResults_InvalidUUID, TestGetResults_Pagination. Worker followed backend-worker skill procedure and used documented services from services.yaml.
